§6Accelerator Vents§f

§aCoolant in, hot coolant out. Without these your accelerator becomes a very expensive bomb.§f

Accelerator vents are port blocks placed on the long sides of any accelerator multiblock. You need at least one input vent and one output vent for active cooling. Pipe in Liquid Helium or another coolant, or watch the temperature climb.

The max temperature before bad things happen is 400. Vents go on the outer walls, not the beamline. Craft them from stainless steel, servomechanisms, and tough alloy. Check JEI for the recipe.

§cWARNING:§f No coolant flow means overheating. Overheating means explosion. Do not skip this.
